predictor_duplicate_caution: Fingerprint excludes identifiers and target; raw duplicate counts are not patient entity linkage.
split_claim: Label-independent patient-grouped retrospective partitions; not site/time or verified policy shift
split_algorithm: SHA256 of UTF8(mira-diabetes-patient-split-v1 + NUL + original patient_nbr), first8 bytes big-endian divided by2^64; train[0,.70), validation[.70,.85), test[.85,1)
split_row_indexing: Zero-based parsed CSV row indices after original header; no row reorder; exclusions applied before assignment
split_status: Proposed preparation manifest; downstream protocol must explicitly adopt before model fitting or evaluation
scope_limits: No encounter dates or hospital ID available; never infer from numeric IDs.
No-record readmission does not prove complete follow-up.
At-discharge timing required for encounter-level clinical features.
Raw categorical code missing/unknown meanings remain separate from physical question-mark tokens.
